notes: Side banner Red Bull is meaningfully smaller than the YoPRO original it replaces — the wordmark and bull silhouette occupy noticeably less of the panel height, leaving extra blue padding above and below. That alone reads as pasted-on. Letter edges on Red Bull show a faint reflex/ringing on the lower stroke and on the bull ring outlines that is absent on YoPRO's crisp serif strokes. Color and brightness on the side banner are well-matched (this surface is in a similar light to the original). Geometry tracks across motion strips without jitter, but the size_plausibility miss is the dominant artifact — sister panels in frame use full panel height and ours doesn't.
